heading: Thursday, September 11, 2025
topLine: Math, Inc.'s Gauss agent completes the Strong Prime Number Theorem formalization. Also: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B.

items.headline: Math, Inc.'s Gauss agent completes the Strong Prime Number Theorem formalization
items.summary: Math, Inc. announced Gauss, an autoformalization agent, which it says completed the Strong Prime Number Theorem formalization challenge set by Terence Tao and Alex Kontorovich in January 2024. The work took about three weeks and produced about 25,000 lines of Lean. The proof compiles in Lean. The timing claims come from Math, Inc., and humans supplied the natural-language blueprint and guidance.

image.alt: Dependency graph of the Strong PNT Lean blueprint

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B
items.summary: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B is an Apache 2.0 open-weight MoE model (80B total, 3B active) using hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, in Instruct and Thinking versions. Qwen says the base model beats Qwen3-32B-Base at about 10% of the training cost with over 10x throughput at contexts above 32K.
